title: Digital Self-Interference Cancellation for In-Band Full-Duplex Systems Based on Transformer Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.19490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital-domain self-interference cancellation is essential in in-band full-duplex radios after passive suppression and analog cancellation. It is particularly challenging when the desired signal is strong relative to the residual self-interference. In this regime, conventional iterative digital cancellers update their coefficients from desired-signal-contaminated received samples and may suffer substantial performance degradation. This paper reformulates digital-domain self-interference cancellation as an operator-learning problem. The proposed framework learns the temporal evolution of the residual self-interference channel from historical observations and uses the learned operator together with the known local transmit signal to reconstruct the current residual self-interference. translated_title: 基于Transformer神经算子的带内全双工系统数字自干扰消除
translated_abstract: 数字域自干扰消除在带内全双工无线电台中，于被动抑制和模拟消除之后是必不可少的。当期望信号相对于残余自干扰较强时，这一任务尤其具有挑战性。在这种场景下，传统的迭代数字消除器会从被期望信号污染的接收样本中更新其系数，可能导致严重的性能下降。本文将数字域自干扰消除重新表述为一个算子学习问题。所提出的框架从历史观测中学习残余自干扰信道的时间演化，并利用学习到的算子结合已知的本地发射信号来重建当前的残余自干扰。该框架采用Transformer神经算子来实现。所得到的方法在无期望信号的环境下进行训练，然后应用于实际场景（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文将带内全双工系统中的数字自干扰消除重新建模为算子学习问题，利用Transformer神经算子从历史观测中学习残余自干扰信道的时间演化，即使在期望信号强于残余自干扰的困难场景下也能实现更优的消除性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates digital self-interference cancellation in in-band full-duplex systems as an operator-learning problem, employing a Transformer neural operator to learn the temporal evolution of the residual self-interference channel, achieving superior cancellation performance even in challenging scenarios where the desired signal is strong relative to residual self-interference.
